basis: Native KiCad XML netlist: cross-boundary node sets between /POWER_SYSTEM/ and all five new subsystems
direction_reference: Direction is relative to the isolated new circuit project

nets.name: ALL_RAILS_PG_HOST
nets.purpose: Buffered all-rails power-good status for main MCU firmware

nets.name: ANA3V3
nets.purpose: Matrix local low-noise regulator input/bias supply

nets.name: ANA5
nets.purpose: DAC analog supplies and matrix ADC/reference circuitry

nets.name: AON
nets.purpose: Always-on supervision and fault-interface bias

nets.name: AUX1V8
nets.purpose: FPGA auxiliary supply

nets.name: CORE1V0
nets.purpose: FPGA core and block-RAM supply

nets.name: DDR1V35
nets.purpose: DDR3L memory and FPGA DDR banks supply

nets.name: DDR_VREF
nets.purpose: DDR3L reference rail, nominal DDR1V35/2; low-noise reference, not general power

nets.name: GLOBAL_PWR_PERMIT_HOST
nets.purpose: Buffered global permit status for main MCU firmware

nets.name: GND
nets.purpose: Common power return, logic reference and analog signal reference

nets.name: HOST_RESET_N
nets.purpose: Active-low host watchdog reset; MCU-local SYS3V3 pull-up and reset button share this node

nets.name: HOST_UART_TX
nets.purpose: Main MCU UART TX to power-manager RX through existing power-sheet series path

nets.name: HOST_WDI

nets.name: IO3V3

nets.name: MATRIX_PERMIT

nets.name: MATRIX_PERMIT_HOST
nets.purpose: Buffered matrix-permit status for main MCU firmware

nets.name: N15
nets.purpose: Negative matrix switch, precision buffer and measurement supply

nets.name: P15
nets.purpose: Positive matrix switch, precision buffer and measurement supply

nets.name: PHY1V05
nets.purpose: Ethernet PHY core supply

nets.name: PM_UART_TX_HOST
nets.purpose: Power-manager UART TX after SYS3V3-powered host buffer; main MCU RX

nets.name: PROG_N15
nets.purpose: Permit-qualified negative forming-DAC and forming-buffer supply

nets.name: PROG_P15
nets.purpose: Permit-qualified positive forming-DAC and forming-buffer supply

nets.name: SYS3V3
nets.purpose: Main STM32, SDRAM, QSPI, microSD and MCU-side logic supply

nets.name: USB5
nets.purpose: Self-powered USB-C orientation/CC controller 5 V supply

nets.name: VTT
nets.purpose: DDR3L termination rail, nominal DDR1V35/2; source/sink capability required

interface_notes: The isolated project expects these rails and supervision signals from the original power system. It does not include converters or power-manager circuits.
Node lists are the actual extracted connection nodes; passive parts may sit between a named boundary and the regulator or MCU terminal.
Nominal voltage entries describe the existing rail names and logic domains, not newly selected power-supply ratings.
No interboard connector, cable pinout, current budget or sequencing firmware is invented here. Physical integration is still required.
MATRIX_INHIBIT_N is an open-drain pull-down into the existing interlock. Do not connect it to the push-pull MATRIX_KILL_H output.
PWR_FLAG may declare an externally driven supply or reference in the interface sheet; it is an ERC assertion, not a source circuit. Never use it to manufacture missing signal drivers.
AUX2V5 has no load connection in the extracted new circuitry and is not a required external connection for this separate project.
